notes.title: Dimension Warrior – Update 1.0.5
notes.content:
New Features & Improvements:  Removed graphics quality options – The game now automatically applies the best visual and performance settings.Added hit visual effect – Enemies now display a visual effect when hit by the player.Improved in-game terminal – Now shows short instructions to explain the basic mechanics of the game.Practice Mode – Allows players to practice boss fights and learn game mechanics. A blocking indicator has been added to show the correct timing for blocking."Normal Mode" – The default game mode now has a proper name.New keybinding options – Players can now freely rebind keys on both keyboard and gamepad.Improved lighting quality – Enhanced lighting on the final map.Terminal repositioned – The in-game terminal has been moved closer to the doors.
Thanks for your support and feedback! 🚀

notes.title: 🔥 Dimension Warrior – NOW AVAILABLE! 🔥
notes.content:
The day has come! The release of Dimension Warrior...
Do you enjoy high difficulty, boss fights, and death...?
Then this is the place for you!

There’s also room for speedrunners!

What is the gameplay like?

You take on the role of a warrior sent on a dangerous mission that can only be completed by defeating five powerful opponents. Can you face them?
Remember, death means restarting the time loop from the beginning...

We’re waiting for your move, warrior!

💬 Leave a review on Steam – we’d appreciate your feedback on the game!
📢 Share clips and screenshots – show off your best time or your most exciting moments in the game!
👀 Join the community – we want to see your strategies, ideas, and the craziest moments!

If you find any bugs in the game, we’d be grateful if you let us know!

Enough talk, time to jump into battle! ⚔️🔥
